title.narrative: Strengthening the Urban Planning Legal and Institutional Frameworks in the Sultanate of Oman

description.narrative:
With significant change in the structure of Ministries and the governance of Oman in August 2020 which has implications for the organisation and operation of most Ministries and the way planning decision making is undertaken at the national and governorate level, there is a strong need for technical support in assessing the legal and institutional framework related to urban planning with a view to catalyse a discussion that will lead to proposals for an urban law and governance reform. Specifically, the project will focus on a road map for developing an effective and new spatial planning Act as well as strengthening the institutional framework and capacity that can facilitate sustainable urban development to reduce the negative effects of rapid urbanization.
To achieve this, the implementation strategy for the project is based on a three-pronged approach comprising of:
(1) Supporting the drafting of the new urban planning law: UN-Habitat will review the current legal and institutional framework to assess its compatibility with the overall urban legal system and will support the conversion of stakeholders’ suggestions into a green paper on the conceptual design for the law and implementation structure.
(2) Capacity development strategy aimed to identify the specific capacity development needs of the Ministry through needs assessment that, to achieve results, is developed in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and through several means (like interviews and discussion groups). With consideration of the results received, UN-Habitat will develop a capacity development strategy.
(3) Stakeholders’ engagement strategy aimed to engage stakeholders in the legislative and governance reform process and foster participatory governance. UN-Habitat will map relevant stakeholders and create focus groups which will take part in the legislative process proposing suggestions and recommendations that will be then integrated in the new draft law. Special attention will be paid to ensure gender balance in the workshops and if possible, creating specific focus group workshops that are targeted at youth and/or women.
